claims.statement: package.json is the kit manifest defining name agent-knowledge-starter 2.0.0, empty dependencies, seven devDependencies, and scripts test (intentional failure), format (remark with .remarkrc.json), and check (bash scripts/check-publish.sh).
openspec.yaml declares the AKSK Knowledge Persistence rule covering .agents/**/*.md and docs/**/*.md with action read-and-reference, while openspec/config.yaml declares schema spec-driven.

Root AGENTS.md is the router entrypoint agents load; in a fully bootstrapped repo it contains marker-delimited managed blocks AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE, OPENWIKI:START/END, AKSK:ROUTING, and AKSK:LIFECYCLE owned respectively by init_agents_md.mjs/refresh_agents_baseline.mjs and attach_section.mjs (canonical in aksk-init, mirrored in aksk-bootstrap). In this checkout the AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE zone is not yet seeded and hand-authored behavioral content precedes the OpenWiki/AKSK blocks, while .agents/AGENTS.md remains the portable source of truth.

The AKSK curation contract between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers is appended from references/wiki-contract-template.md (canonical in aksk-init, mirrored in aksk-bootstrap) by attach_wiki_contract.mjs without creating, replacing, or removing OpenWiki-owned content, and is idempotent/self-updating.

Peer binaries @fission-ai/openspec and openwiki plus Node >=22 are never installed by the kit; caret versions resolve from .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/references/versions.json (fallback @latest) and verification is via check_peer_tools.mjs which fails fast exit 2 printing exact npm i -g commands and rejecting unknown tool names, while bootstrap-global.mjs (global lane) and aksk-init bootstrap-repo.mjs (per-repo lane) own automated per-user global install; bootstrap.mjs is a shim sequencing both lanes.
.agents/.gitignore enforces sessions/* with exception !sessions/README.md so only sessions/README.md is tracked and every sessions/<bundle>/ remains local evidence.

scripts/check-agents-structure.sh is a portable validator scoped to a single target directory (default .agents, normalized via ${target%/}) with sections: structure existence, required-files manifest via -f, git-aware session tracking (git ls-files vs single expected README), skill frontmatter header check (--- plus name/description in first 12 lines), and JSON validation via jq empty when available.

scripts/check-publish.sh is the starter-repo publish wrapper (npm run check) that runs check-agents-structure.sh on root .agents then remark --frail (60s timeout via direct remark or npx --no-install), markdown-link-check --alive 200,0 per markdown file (30s timeout), a printed .agents file list, rg leakage scan and doubled .agents/.agents path check, degrading optional tools npx/rg/timeout/jq to WARN/skip.

Node >=22 is the single runtime for all ESM helpers under .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts and .agents/skills/aksk-init/scripts including bootstrap-global.mjs, bootstrap-repo.mjs, bootstrap.mjs shim, check_peer_tools.mjs, attach_wiki_contract.mjs, attach_section.mjs, sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, init_agents_md.mjs and refresh_agents_baseline.mjs.

bootstrap-global.mjs (global lane) and bootstrap-repo.mjs (per-repo lane) are deterministic idempotent orchestrators with EXECUTE lane (run locally) and INSTRUCT lane (print exact remaining commands and exit clean); re-runs complete only missing steps and a failed step leaves no partial state; bootstrap.mjs shims both lanes sequentially.

.agents portable zone separates concerns: .agents/AGENTS.md stays small with concise directives, .agents/playbooks holds durable multi-step procedures (pre-publish, major-version-release), .agents/skills provides portable logic with CONTRACT.md, and .agents/sessions holds gitignored per-task bundles validated by the portable validator.

openspec/config.yaml defines spec-driven context and proposal/design/tasks rules; openspec/specs/** is the shipped contract (12 capabilities), openspec/changes/** are proposal-only deltas, and openspec/changes/archive/** is historical until openspec archive graduates specs.

Curated decisions/ and troubleshooting/ trees are OKF pages with aksk_status/aksk_depends_on extensions authored by learning-distill, preserved across OpenWiki updates via preserve-and-link, indexes refreshed by sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, and concurrent edits are guarded by the documented .run.json check before editing.

.openwikiignore at repo root excludes .agents/sessions/ (with !.agents/sessions/README.md exception) as generated non-canonical tree; .agents/sessions bundles are treated as temporary local evidence, not shipped behavior.

.remarkrc.json configures markdown style (bullet -, rule -, emphasis *) with remark-frontmatter and remark-gfm plugins, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json lists the five portable user skills aksk-bootstrap, aksk-init, task-closeout, learning-distill and docs-lint.

.agents/skills/verify-install is an internal maintainer skill not listed in plugin.json, while the five portable skills are validated by the required-files manifest and skill-frontmatter checks in check-agents-structure.sh.
